crossRefs.note: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside…
Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a…
Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”
Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, ‘because you have brought no…
Don’t you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
translations.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
translations.asv: And he saith unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how shall ye know all the parables?
